item.description: PowerPoint is introducing "Create interactive slides" for Windows, Mac, and web, enabling users to make interactive visuals for complex concepts and data. Available first to Microsoft 365 Insider Beta and Frontier users, rollout completes by October 2026. No action required; admins should prepare support and training.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to streamline Quick Campaigns for confident, one-time bulk email outreach in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach public preview on September 25, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature allows you to use an enhanced Quick Campaign experience that keeps one-time bulk emails, post-meeting follow-ups, event or webinar recaps, policy updates, or announcements to many customers at once in a single, streamlined flow. item.title: MC1478975: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Use Microsoft Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
item.description: Microsoft 365 now supports Microsoft Agent 365 agents using the Agent2Agent protocol as connected agents in declarative agents, enhancing AI interactions and workflows. Administrators manage and approve these agents via the Microsoft 365 admin center. Rollout begins late August 2026, expanding flexibility and governance for developers and users.

item.title: MC1478970: Microsoft Purview | DLP-Create Purview network data security policies without pay-as-you-go configuration
item.description: Microsoft Purview network data security policies can now be created without pay-as-you-go configuration, using Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access with appropriate licensing. Non-Microsoft integrations still require pay-as-you-go. Rollout begins late September 2026, enabling policy creation to protect sensitive data in network traffic automatically.

item.title: MC1478969: Deprecation of Citrix mVPN Support in Microsoft Edge for Android
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Android will retire Citrix Mobile VPN (mVPN) integration starting mid-September 2026 due to compatibility issues. Organizations using this integration must identify affected users, assess dependencies, plan migration to alternative solutions, and communicate changes before support ends. Other Edge features remain unaffected.

item.title: MC1478966: SharePoint: Improved site metadata size reporting
item.description: SharePoint will improve site metadata size reporting by including document library field data, providing a more complete usage view. The 1 TB metadata limit remains, but reported sizes may increase, potentially blocking new metadata additions if exceeded. Rollout starts October 20, 2026, with no content changes.

item.title: MC1478965: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will support retention of inactive Microsoft 365 Copilot memory versions for compliance and investigation. Historical memory items are stored in users' Exchange mailboxes, accessible via eDiscovery. Rollout begins late September 2026. No immediate action is required; organizations should review retention policies and governance.

item.title: MC1478958: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Select page canvas elements for Copilot-assisted editing
item.description: SharePoint Online now lets page authors with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license select specific page canvas elements for targeted Copilot editing, improving precision and user experience. This feature is generally available worldwide with no action required.

item.title: MC1478957: Microsoft 365 profile card: View dotted-line managers in the organization panel
item.description: Microsoft 365 profile cards will show dotted-line managers in the organization panel starting October 2026, helping users understand complex reporting structures. This additive update requires organizations to provide dotted-line manager data via HR systems like SAP SuccessFactors or Workday. No action is required unless enabling this feature.

item.title: MC1478956: Microsoft Windows Autopatch: enhancements to update approval control and management capabilities
item.description: Windows Autopatch enhancements, rolling out Sept 1–Oct 15, 2026, offer improved control over Windows quality, .NET Framework, and quick machine recovery updates. Features include customizable automatic/manual approvals, deferral settings, update pausing, and detailed per-device reporting for better update management.

item.title: MC1478955: Final reminder: Microsoft Project Online retires on September 30, 2026
item.description: Microsoft Project Online will retire on September 30, 2026. Users must migrate to alternatives like Microsoft Planner, Project Server Subscription Edition, or Project Operations before then to avoid data loss. Organizations should contact a Microsoft partner immediately to plan the transition and notify users accordingly.

item.title: MC1478949: Breakout Rooms for Microsoft Teams Webinars now support up to 1,000 participants and 100 rooms
item.description: Breakout Rooms in Microsoft Teams webinars now support up to 1,000 participants and 100 rooms, enabling large-scale interactive sessions like training and workshops. No admin action is needed; organizers should be informed and guidance updated accordingly. No compliance issues identified. Available now.

item.title: MC1478946: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Extended rollback support for Monthly Enterprise Channel
item.description: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update will allow Monthly Enterprise Channel devices to roll back to releases from two versions prior with security updates, maintaining that state until updates resume. Rolling out worldwide in September 2026, this feature enhances recovery options without automatic changes to devices.

item.title: RM570859: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Enhanced visibility into work order financial performance
item.description: The new Work Order Cost Summary gives field teams a clearer view of how project-related work is performing by bringing estimated and actual costs, sales, and project task progress together in one place. Teams can quickly compare what was planned with what was actually delivered across products, services, and expenses.

item.title: RM570858: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Support multiple warehouse assignments for field technicians
item.description: Field technicians often source parts from more than one warehouse. Limiting a technician to a single warehouse can make it harder to reflect how materials are actually sourced across field operations.

item.title: RM558547: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
item.description: Speed up analysis of exfiltrated content by launching Data Security Investigations (DSI) from endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alerts. In DSI, define your endpoint DLP query (for example, time range, users, and endpoints). DSI then automatically gathers the related files that triggered the alerts for review (for example, UserA downloaded a file on 3/1/2026).

item.title: RM571157: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
item.description: We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation.

item.title: RM566700: Microsoft Teams: IntelliFrame people labels in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Remote meeting participants know who is in the room and better follow the conversation with new IntelliFrame people labels that identify in-room participants and provide a hover-over contact card using voice and face profiles on intelligent cameras and in the cloud. Available with Teams Rooms on Windows licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM566324: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Adaptive Protection integration with Data Lifecycle Management
item.description: Adaptive Protection in Microsoft Purview helps you protect your organization’s data by integrating dynamic insider risk levels, determined by data related activities, with various policy engines to automatically moving users in and out of policies as their risk levels change over time. The integration with Data Lifecycle Management will automatically apply retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on a user’s insider risk level.

item.title: RM566322: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
item.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

item.title: RM560700: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM571683: Outlook: Insert Symbol
item.description: You can insert a variety of symbols into an email message while composing it. To add a symbol, go to the Insert tab and select Symbols.

item.title: RM554934: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

item.title: MC1419798: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels by mid-November 2026, displaying names and contact cards of enrolled in-room participants to improve hybrid meeting clarity. The feature enables automatic labeling based on voice and face recognition, requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, and respects existing enrollment policies.

item.title: MC791110: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: New integration with Adaptive protection
item.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing a public preview of Adaptive protection integration with Data Lifecycle Management, automatically retaining deleted content from elevated risk users for 120 days. Rollout begins June 2024, with general availability in late 2026. Admins can enable this feature via the Purview compliance portal.

item.title: MC1307888: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Android, enabling real-time note-taking during in-person meetings. Notes are securely stored in tenant-owned SharePoint and accessible via meeting recap. Rollout begins early November 2026, requiring Teams Rooms Pro licenses and specific tenant settings.

item.title: MC1478467: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Admin-configurable compliance URL in M365 Copilot data access messages
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP now lets admins configure the destination URL for the "Learn about access restrictions" link in Microsoft 365 Copilot data access messages. This directs users to organization-specific compliance guidance instead of Microsoft's public documentation. The feature rolls out worldwide in late September 2026 and requires admin configuration.

item.title: MC1478465: Security Copilot is now included as part of your Microsoft 365 E5/E7 plan
item.description: Security Copilot is now included with Microsoft 365 E5/E7 plans, integrating agents across Defender, Entra, Intune, Purview, and its portal. No purchase or action is needed. Organizations get monthly Security Compute Units, developer tools, and can explore additional paid features or opt out by contacting support.

item.title: MC1478463: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Teams user reporting enabled by default
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will enable Teams user reporting by default starting late October 2026 for licensed organizations. Users can report suspicious Teams content to improve threat detection. Admins can review or opt out via a dedicated Defender portal page before October 25, 2026.

item.title: MC1392568: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint: Support for Amazon Linux 2 (ARM64) retiring October 31, 2026
item.description: Support for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on Amazon Linux 2 (ARM64) will retire on October 31, 2026. After this date, no updates or support will be provided. Organizations must identify affected devices, prevent upgrades beyond version 101.25122.0004, and migrate to a supported Linux distribution before the deadline.

item.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on Linux now requires allowlisting new service URLs specific to tenant types for delivering internal configuration updates, feature rollouts, and critical issue mitigations. item.title: RM562340: Microsoft Teams: Preloaded video for Teams Events and Meetings
item.description: Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees.

item.title: RM567314: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint app in Teams

item.title: RM566856: Microsoft Teams: Additional health signals available for Teams Rooms on Android on Pro Management Portal
item.description: Expanded Pro Management Portal (PMP) health monitoring for Teams Rooms on Android by surfacing device health signals including storage health, Teams meeting app, calendar sync, secondary display health and network. When issues are detected, PMP will automatically generate actionable alerts and support ticket creation workflows, enabling IT administrators to proactively identify and triage room health issues before they impact meeting experiences.

item.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

item.title: MC1478006: Microsoft Word for the web: Retirement of the "@" entity insertion experience on the document canvas
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the CIQ-based "@" entity insertion on Word for the web's document canvas by late October 2026, aligning it with other Microsoft 365 apps. Users cannot invoke this menu anymore, but @mentions in comments remain unaffected. No admin action is required; users should be informed.

item.title: MC1478005: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: View approver details for remediation actions in Advanced Hunting
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 added an ApproverUpn column to the EmailPostDeliveryEvents table in Advanced Hunting, showing who approved remediation actions. This enables faster investigations without using Action Center. The feature is available worldwide, enabled by default, and requires no action from administrators.

item.title: MC1478003: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
item.description: Microsoft Teams will let admins control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts via a new meeting policy setting, on by default. Turning it off allows profane words to appear in live and saved transcripts. This affects meeting policies, not participant caption preferences, and rolls out October 2026.

item.title: MC1477999: Microsoft Teams: Removing Copilot from the chat list
item.description: Starting October 2026, Microsoft Teams will remove the Copilot chat list entry point, directing users to access Copilot solely through the Copilot app in the Teams app bar for a streamlined experience. Mobile users are unaffected, and no data will be lost. No action is required.

item.title: MC1477996: Retirement of Viva Insights (personal insights) and Viva Learning usage reports
item.description: Viva Insights personal insights and Viva Learning usage reports will be retired from the Microsoft 365 admin center by mid-November 2026. Admins should access Viva Learning metrics directly in the app and update documentation and communications accordingly.

item.title: MC1477993: Case Management in Microsoft Defender
item.description: Microsoft Defender introduces native Case Management to unify threat investigations, assign analysts, track SLAs, and capture notes in one workspace. Launching in public preview September 2026, it integrates with existing workflows and permissions, enhancing security team coordination and response efficiency without requiring manual migration.

item.title: MC1461165: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can join channel meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow adding Facilitator to channel meetings starting early November 2026. Facilitator can take notes, manage agendas, answer questions, and handle tasks. No action or compliance changes are required. The rollout completes worldwide by early December 2026.

item.title: MC999442: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Retention based on “last accessed” for OneDrive and SharePoint files
item.description: Admins can apply retention policies in OneDrive and SharePoint to delete Office files based on their last accessed date, starting preview in late November 2026 and general availability in January 2027. This improves data relevance for Microsoft 365 Copilot. No admin action is needed before rollout.

item.title: MC1470424: Microsoft Viva Engage: New left navigation controls for collapsing, resizing, and managing favorites
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage is updating its left navigation with features to collapse, resize, reorder, and favorite unlimited communities. These user-initiated enhancements improve organization and efficiency across web, Teams, and Outlook platforms, rolling out worldwide by October 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1409042: Microsoft OneNote: Copilot notebook available in OneNote on Mac
item.description: Copilot Notebook, a new AI-powered workspace in OneNote on Mac, helps users organize and analyze notes using Microsoft 365 Copilot. It requires a Copilot license, is enabled by default, and will roll out worldwide from late August to mid-October 2026. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1472591: Enhanced security and access controls for Outlook attachments
item.description: Outlook attachments now use a separate application configuration enforcing existing Conditional Access policies for download, preview, and upload. Non-compliant users are blocked from attachment actions. Admins should review policies, update help desk guidance, and notify users. Excluding attachments from policies requires creating a service principal for OwaDownloadAttachments.

item.title: MC1477187: Microsoft OneDrive: OneDrive sync supports up to 1 million items on macOS
item.description: OneDrive sync on macOS will increase its item limit from 300,000 to 1 million per device, starting with a Public Preview in mid-October 2026 for Insiders ring users. Devices not meeting hardware requirements will remain at the current limit, with no disruption expected.

item.title: MC1477186: Microsoft Agent 365: Simplified Agent 365 CLI setup experience
item.description: Agent 365 CLI setup is simplified with a Microsoft-managed enterprise application, removing the need for tenant-owned client apps. Existing setups remain unchanged. The update respects security controls, requires no action for current users, and recommends updating to the latest CLI version and reviewing authentication guidance.

item.title: MC1477185: Microsoft OneDrive: New pay-as-you-go storage billing option
item.description: Microsoft OneDrive introduces a pay-as-you-go storage billing option, allowing admins to let selected accounts exceed licensed storage quotas with automatic usage-based billing. Public preview is available now; general availability starts November 2026. No action is required unless opting in. Compliance impact is minimal.

item.title: MC1477184: Microsoft 365 admin center: Agent Registry consolidates duplicate agent entries and adds version history
item.description: The Microsoft 365 admin center's Agent Registry will consolidate duplicate agent entries into single records with version history, simplifying management. This change, rolling out worldwide in September 2026, affects admins and may alter agent counts and related reports. No action is required, but review of dependent processes is recommended.

item.title: MC1477182: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to cover Microsoft Cowork, applying existing and new DLP policies from Microsoft Copilot automatically. This includes sensitivity label grounding, prompt blocking, and web search DLP for sensitive data. Rollout begins late September 2026 with no required user action.

item.title: MC1477181: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Apply default SharePoint library sensitivity labels to data at rest
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enable an auto-labeling policy to apply default SharePoint library sensitivity labels to existing files, improving labeling coverage without user action. This opt-in feature, rolling out in October 2026, requires administrator configuration and supports up to 10 SharePoint sites per policy.

item.title: RM570861: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Choose how work order services flow into project financials
item.description: Organizations can now control how work order services contribute to project financials when using Dynamics 365 Field Service and Project Operations together. A new administrator-level setting lets organizations choose whether work order services flow as time or material transactions based on how they manage field execution and technician labor.

item.title: RM570962: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
item.description: Multi-line users get a redesigned call history experience that organizes activity by phone line. Call activity is organized into dedicated tabs for each line, so history, voicemails, and recordings appear under the line they belong to, making navigation and call management simpler and more intuitive.

item.title: RM570843: Microsoft Teams: Upgraded call history in Teams Calls app
item.description: Call history in the Teams Calls app is being upgraded to make it easier to find and act on past call activity. Missed calls and associated voicemails will be consolidated into a single call history entry, reducing clutter and simplifying follow-up. Call history will also expand from 100 records to up to 3,000 records or 6 months of history, whichever limit is reached first, giving users more context when they need it.

item.description: Microsoft Teams automatically organizes your chats with new built in sections that help reduce clutter and keep conversations easy to find. item.title: RM558254: Microsoft Teams: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts
item.description: Microsoft Teams preserves @mentions and shared contacts when you copy and paste messages in chats and channels. Instead of defaulting to plain text, Teams intelligently displays an @mention, shared contact, or plain text based on where the content is pasted, reducing manual rework.

Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. item.description: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal, similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today. item.title: MC1447682: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced live captions settings and right-side panel view
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing live captions with a new right-side panel view and a consolidated settings menu for easier configuration. item.title: MC1443520: Microsoft Teams: Specify who has control of production tools in meetings and webinars
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a default meeting option allowing organizers to specify who controls production tools in meetings and webinars, improving event management by assigning production roles separately from presenters. item.title: MC1429012: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing call delegation with a new "Lock an Ongoing Call" feature to restrict delegate participation and an optional warning tone notifying when a delegate joins or resumes a call. These updates improve privacy and transparency during delegated calls, rolling out globally from August to October 2026.

item.title: MC1332816: Scoped SharePoint search in Teams (SharePoint app, also called Viva Connections)
item.description: Starting end of June 2026, Teams' SharePoint app (Viva Connections) search will scope results to SharePoint content, showing suggestions in Teams and opening results in SharePoint. The feature is default-enabled, respects permissions, requires no admin changes, and aims to improve search relevance within Teams.

item.title: MC1324280: Assign open shifts in Microsoft Teams Shifts
item.description: Microsoft Teams Shifts introduces "Assign open shifts," enabling managers to automatically assign open shifts based on availability, time off, historical patterns, and rules. Rolling out worldwide from mid-June to October 2026, the feature is optional, reviewable before publishing, and controlled by existing scheduling permissions.

item.title: MC1317836: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to send messages while files upload asynchronously in the background, improving real-time collaboration. item.title: MC1316231: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Webinars and structured meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will default front-of-room displays to attendee view during webinars and structured meetings starting mid-June 2026, enhancing in-room participant experience. Presenters keep full control via console. The feature requires a Teams Rooms Pro license, is enabled by default, and needs no user action.

item.title: MC1323270: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) support for Teams meetings and events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for town halls and live events starting June 2026, alongside existing RTMP. SRT offers improved reliability with backup streams and automatic failover. IT admins must enable SRT via policy. No impact on attendees; existing workflows remain supported.

item.title: MC1251206: Microsoft Teams: Identify external bots joining your Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect and label external meeting assistant bots joining meetings, giving organizers control to approve, deny, or remove them. A new admin policy will manage bot handling. Rollout begins mid-May 2026, completing by October 2026, enhancing meeting security and compliance.

item.title: MC1257308: Microsoft Teams: Building‑level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: Microsoft is adding building-level insights to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal's recommended actions page, highlighting buildings with high Teams Rooms usage and BYOD rooms to improve consistency. This feature, enabled by default for eligible licenses, will roll out from mid-June to October 2026 worldwide. No action is required.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to sync transaction categories for retainers and milestones between Microsoft Dataverse and Dynamics 365 in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. item.title: MC1261595: Microsoft Teams town halls now support backup Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) streams
item.description: Microsoft Teams town halls will support backup RTMP streams to improve live event reliability, automatically switching to a secondary stream if the primary fails. This feature, available by default with no admin setup needed, rolls out worldwide from late April to October 2026, affecting organizers using RTMP workflows.

item.title: MC1256307: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
item.description: Microsoft Teams will sync recently used emojis and reactions across all devices by late July 2026 (general availability). The feature is enabled by default, requires no user action, and maintains existing admin settings without impacting data flow or compliance. Admins may update documentation or inform support teams.

item.title: MC1045221: Microsoft Teams: New user setting to view incoming calls in a small window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new default setting allowing users to view incoming calls in a small, resizable window to reduce disruption. The feature will roll out from May 2025 to October 2026 across all platforms, requiring no admin action but user notification is recommended.

item.description: Update: Release of this feature has been postponed; we will announce a new date in the future. item.title: MC1438571: Default visibility of additional profile card properties in Microsoft 365 profile cards
item.description: Microsoft 365 will change the default visibility of 11 profile card properties to display by default when populated, starting late October 2026. Administrators can review and hide specific properties using Microsoft Graph APIs before rollout. Visibility management remains available via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1269864: Microsoft Teams: New chat sections for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. Rollout starts mid-October 2026, completing by mid-November. Users can enable, disable, and reorder these sections; no admin action is required.

item.title: RM557563: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
item.description: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

item.title: RM570446: Microsoft Viva: Ability for leaders to publish Power BI reports
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is extending its report publishing capabilities from analysts to leader personas such as Chief Officers, Managers and their delegates. This enhancement enables leaders to directly distribute curated reports within their organizations through a lightweight publishing experience, complementing the existing report customization features.

item.title: RM571390: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
item.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

item.title: RM571387: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
item.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter or any participant’s video into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

item.title: RM503772: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents
item.description: Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.

item.title: RM503553: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Authoritative content management for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
item.description: Specify and manage SharePoint sites deemed as authoritative content to enhance their relevance and ranking in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search. item.title: RM571193: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Inactivate quality evaluation records
item.description: Quality managers can now inactivate evaluation records that should no longer contribute to scoring or reporting. Inactive evaluations are preserved for traceability but excluded from overall score calculations and analytics. This helps teams correct reporting outcomes when evaluations were created in error, used the wrong criteria, were duplicates, or should otherwise be removed from active quality results.

item.title: RM571302: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Quality evaluation supports knowledge source in criteria
item.description: Criteria questions can now use knowledge sources to help evaluate customer interactions. This allows organizations to ground evaluation criteria in approved knowledge content, policies, or guidance so quality checks can better reflect expected handling standards. This preview capability is scoped to case and on-demand evaluations.

item.title: RM571879: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings
item.description: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings gives organizations greater control over access to sensitive meetings. Administrators can apply Conditional Access policies to selected meetings, helping ensure participants meet organizational security requirements before joining.

item.title: RM558933: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
item.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.

item.title: RM560076: SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
item.description: This feature empowers authors to create rich, interactive charts with AI in SharePoint when editing SharePoint pages. Authors can describe the chart they want to create in plain language within a chat on a SharePoint page.

item.title: RM560822: SharePoint: eSignature for Microsoft 365 - Recipient groups
item.description: Recipient groups in eSignature allow a recipient slot to be assigned to multiple people, such that any one of those people can fulfil the signing requirement on behalf of the group.

item.title: RM562017: Microsoft Viva: Fresh Copilot Metrics in Custom Person Queries & Reports- Viva Advanced Analysis
item.description: Key Microsoft 365 Copilot metrics in custom person queries and reports will have values up to 2-3 days old from the current date. This will provide fresher copilot usage analysis to analysts in Viva Advanced analysis.

item.title: RM562343: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
item.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

item.title: RM559017: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Pay‑As‑You‑Go usage
item.description: Enables metered, pay‑as‑you‑go access to Work IQ endpoints, allowing developers to invoke agents and capabilities without requiring pre‑assigned licenses, with usage billed based on the agents and models invoked per request.

item.title: RM565222: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
item.description: Self-service diagnostics help identify common issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. The experience highlights potential misconfigurations and provides simple guidance to help customers understand and resolve them. This brings basic troubleshooting into the product and helps eDiscovery admins overcome common challenges.

item.title: RM566527: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
item.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

item.title: RM568782: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
item.description: Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.

item.title: RM569019: Microsoft Teams: Identify custom apps that need updates for Teams private and shared channels
item.description: Admins will be able to view in Teams Admin Center a list of custom apps in their tenant that need to be updated to work in private and shared channels. This experience will help admins identify impacted apps, understand which apps require developer action, and coordinate updates so users can continue using custom apps across all supported channel types.

item.title: RM569207: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

item.title: RM570846: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
item.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

item.title: RM571191: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Detailed quality evaluation score breakdown
item.description: Evaluation details now include a scoring breakdown at the overall, section, and question level. Users can see how the final evaluation score was calculated, including how individual question outcomes contribute to section scores and the overall score. This improves transparency, helps quality teams validate results, and makes it easier to identify areas for coaching, calibration, and process improvement.

item.title: RM571192: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Support Not Applicable answer option for quality evaluation criteria
item.description: Criteria questions now support a Not Applicable answer option. When a question is marked as not applicable, it is excluded from scoring instead of negatively affecting the evaluation score. This helps ensure evaluations remain accurate when a specific criterion does not apply to the case, interaction, or business scenario being reviewed.

item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Surveys agent by August 31, 2026, transitioning users to a unified Copilot-powered experience within Microsoft Forms. item.description: Microsoft 365 eSignature introduces recipient groups, allowing up to 10 people per recipient slot, with the first signer fulfilling the requirement. item.title: MC1429018: Microsoft Teams: AI meeting archive file generation
item.description: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting archive files starting early November 2026 to improve Copilot and Facilitator responses while ensuring privacy. item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft will redirect users from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft. item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable AI-assisted time-off and swap requests in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 1, 2026. item.description: The Microsoft Copilot app now supports in-app browsing on Windows and Mac, allowing users to open websites side-by-side with chat. item.description: Microsoft Purview now integrates with the Island Enterprise Browser to extend data loss prevention and network data security to browser-based workflows. item.title: RM562993: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention — Endpoint DLP now supports a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition
item.description: Endpoint DLP now includes a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition. This helps improve policy reliability and reduces unnecessary processing on endpoints.

item.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

item.description: Intelligent meeting recap uses AI to provide a quick summary of your meeting, highlighting key discussion points, identifying follow-up actions, and offering quick access to significant points such as name mentions, when a screen was shared, individualized speaker markers, topics, and chapters.

item.description: Finance teams rely on journals for high-volume accounting processes, where performance, accuracy, and visibility are critical to keeping financial operations moving. The new financial journal capabilities in Dynamics 365 Finance will provide a more scalable approach to creating, importing, reviewing, and posting journals, helping finance teams reduce manual steps and identify issues earlier in the process.

item.title: RM571637: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork for Government Clouds
item.description: Copilot Cowork makes it easy to delegate work. Describe the outcome you want and Cowork automatically grounds the work in your emails, meetings, messages, files, and data.

item.title: RM571392: Planner: Expiration of plans from meetings due to inactivity
item.description: Planner plans created from Teams meetings (via Meeting Notes or Loop) often remain unused long after the meeting ends. These inactive plans accumulate and clutter over time. Only the Planner plan is removed whereas the tasks in Loop and meeting notes stay intact.

item.title: RM571307: Microsoft Edge: Autolaunch opt-in experience for managed devices
item.description: Microsoft Edge will introduce an opt-in experience that allows users on managed devices to choose whether Edge launches automatically when Windows starts. Administrators can also manage this behavior through the LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled policy with opt-in, opt-out, and user-choice configurations.

item.title: RM571306: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
item.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. item.title: MC1384415: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now supports a pre‑curated file extension list
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now uses a pre-curated list of supported, scannable file extensions for policy configuration, improving accuracy and enforcement consistency. item.description: Microsoft is updating how EWSAllowedAppIDs is applied in Exchange Online as part of EWS retirement starting October 1, 2026. item.title: MC1474111: Retirement of Microsoft 365 Companion apps
item.description: Microsoft 365 companion apps (Calendar, People, Files) will retire on December 16, 2026, ceasing support and functionality. Admins must stop new installations and remove existing apps. Core Microsoft 365 features remain unaffected, accessible via Outlook, Teams, and other tools. Users should be informed and guided accordingly.

item.title: MC1474110: Microsoft Planner: Capacity view
item.description: Capacity view in Microsoft Planner, launching October 2026, shows a live staffing timeline from existing task data for Plan 3 users on web/desktop (Teams, Outlook). It helps spot workload distribution without extra reports. No admin action needed; keep task details updated for accuracy.

item.title: MC1474107: Microsoft Purview: Archive file classification behavior change for Endpoint Data Loss Prevention on Windows endpoints
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP on Windows will classify archive files (.zip, .rar) as single atomic objects, reporting only the outer archive in events. This change, rolling out from September to November 2026, improves consistency and performance without requiring user or admin action.

item.title: MC1474106: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: New MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Microsoft Teams messages
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 introduces a new MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Teams messages, enabling authorized security analysts to query message snippets and metadata for threat investigations. It rolls out worldwide from late September to mid-October 2026, requiring appropriate permissions for access.

item.title: MC1474104: Microsoft Entra ID: Follow-up on SMS first-factor sign-in retirement and upcoming changes
item.description: Microsoft is retiring SMS first-factor sign-in for Microsoft Entra ID workforce tenants worldwide starting February 1, 2027, to enhance security. Organizations must identify affected users, migrate them to phishing-resistant methods like passkeys, and update policies to avoid sign-in disruptions and comply with new requirements.

item.title: RM570441: Outlook: Multi Account Search
item.description: Users will be able to see results from multiple mailboxes interweaved in a single ranked list and will be able to do standard mail actions.

item.title: RM500872: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
item.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

item.title: RM554938: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Autofill
item.description: For desktop users, Microsoft Edge can now autofill additional document types—including passports, driver’s licenses, and other specialized forms—on top of your saved addresses.

item.title: RM558435: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service

item.title: MC1470410: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection for messages from external users
item.description: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can choose to reveal these images if trusted. No admin action is needed, but user education on QR code safety is recommended. This applies across all Teams platforms.

item.title: MC1282683: Create and edit SharePoint pages with Copilot-powered AI
item.description: SharePoint page editors with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license can now use an AI-powered authoring panel to create and edit pages via natural language prompts, leveraging existing Microsoft 365 content. The feature, rolling out worldwide by September 2026, is enabled by default and allows switching between AI and manual editing.

item.title: MC1466753: Microsoft Word: Similarity Checker retirement
item.description: Microsoft Word's Similarity Checker will be retired on October 3, 2027, and removed from Microsoft Editor. Other writing and editing features, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, remain unaffected. Organizations should review workflows, inform users, and consider alternatives if needed. No action or compliance issues are required.

item.description: Updated September 10, 2026: The September 2026 Scan Cab includes metadata for Microsoft Office update (KB5002923). item.title: MC1469958: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection increases auto-labeling simulation capacity from 4 million to 20 million items, expands SharePoint site targeting, and enhances reporting with Sensitive Information Type summaries and processing charts. Rollout begins September 2026 with no end-user impact or required action.

item.title: MC1470296: Windows Office Hours: September 17, 2026
item.description: If you are an IT admin with questions about managing and updating Windows, we want to help. Every third Thursday of the month, we host a live chat-based event on the Tech Community called Windows Office Hours. Members of the Windows, Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Windows Autopatch, and Windows 365 engineering teams will be standing by to answer your questions. item.title: MC1430536: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Unified alert queue
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is unifying classic alerts and AI-driven triage into a single alert queue, enhancing analyst efficiency with integrated agent insights, filtering, and prioritization. The classic experience will be deprecated by October 2026, with a 60-day transition period and no immediate action required.

item.title: RM570647: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
item.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

item.title: RM570440: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
item.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

item.title: RM568364: Microsoft Viva: Rolling out Custom branding in Engage
item.description: Engage is rolling out Custom Branding, a new admin-led capability that lets organizations define a customized, tenant-wide visual identity across the Engage web and mobile apps. Engage-level admins can configure a brand name, add large and small logos, and a theme color that is applied consistently for all users in the tenant. Branding is managed from the new Brand Center in the Viva Engage admin center and helps organizations reinforce their identity throughout the Engage experience.

item.title: RM567895: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
item.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

item.title: RM569447: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

item.title: RM472031: Data Loss Prevention- DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
item.description: Copilot for Security in DLP can summarize DLP policies. This enhancement enables DLP admins to gain insights on coverage of policies viz. location, classifiers and notifications, and more.

item.title: RM476488: Microsoft Teams: Ability to separate out the Townhall attendee invites
item.description: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew. This feature allows the organizers of Townhalls to maintain separate invites for attendees.

item.title: RM486828: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Apply a retention policy to Microsoft Planner content
item.description: Introducing Data lifecycle management capabilities for Microsoft Planner. Compliance admins can now create a retention policy to manage content located in Microsoft Planner such as tasks for plans associated with an Microsoft 365 Group.

item.title: RM493742: Microsoft Teams: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GCC
item.description: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GGC provides Teams admins with insights into external collaboration patterns - covering teams, federated domains, channels, guests, and internal users - along with recommended actions to enhance security for external collaboration.

item.title: RM543713: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

item.title: RM561490: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

item.title: RM561857: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Topic Assignments Included in Comment Report Export
item.description: When exporting comments to spreadsheet from the Comments report, the topic(s) assigned to each comment will be included in the export.

item.title: RM561204: Planner: My Tasks redesign
item.description: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

item.title: RM567671: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
item.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

item.title: MC1469962: Change in sender email address for Copilot emails
item.description: Microsoft is updating the sender email for Copilot-related educational and enablement emails to microsoftcopilotupdates@microsoft.com by mid-September 2026. Organizations should update mail flow rules and safe sender lists accordingly. The email content remains unchanged, and no tenant action is required for rollout.

item.title: MC1469961: Microsoft Viva Glint: Copilot features are no longer available for cross-tenant guest users
item.description: Starting August 26, 2026, Microsoft Viva Glint's Copilot features will be unavailable to Microsoft Entra cross-tenant guest users due to underlying service limitations. Affected users will no longer see Copilot functionalities, but other Viva Glint features remain unchanged. No admin action or Copilot license assignment will restore access.

item.title: MC1466751: Microsoft Teams: Lobby visibility will align with the "Who can admit from lobby" meeting option
item.description: Starting early September 2026, Microsoft Teams will align lobby visibility with the "Who can admit from lobby" setting, so only those allowed to admit participants can see the lobby. This change improves privacy, is automatic, and may affect meeting workflows involving presenters monitoring the lobby.

item.title: RM499153: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enhanced personalization with memory in Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will improve memory in Copilot by increasing the relevance and quality of Copilot responses based on previous communications. This AI-powered capability improves the relevance and quality of Copilot responses by learning from previous communications. These memories are private to the user.

item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, providing easier access and AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins late September 2026 worldwide, with no license or admin changes. No action is required, but communication and documentation updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1446797: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will receive a modernized Gallery view starting mid-August 2026, aligning with Windows experience by improving participant visibility, consistent layouts, and meeting display controls. Admins can configure settings; no action is required before rollout. Audio participants will be deprioritized when video is prioritized.

item.title: MC1443518: Microsoft Teams: Expanded presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing presenter visibility in "Manage what attendees see" by allowing event organizers and producers to drag and resize the presenter panel, showing more presenters simultaneously. This improves monitoring, transitions, and management of large events, rolling out from mid-August to late September 2026. No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1462473: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
item.description: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams will add a light mode option alongside dark, classic, and high contrast modes for presenters starting September 2026. This update enhances flexibility, accessibility, and personalization without affecting presentation content or attendee views. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1461164: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: room users can change the app language
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will allow users to temporarily change the app language per session from the console, aligning with Windows experience. This feature rolls out from June to October 2026 with app version 2.12.0+, resets after restart, requires no admin action, and does not affect system settings.

item.title: MC1146821: Rewrite with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat coming soon to Edge for Business users
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Business will roll out the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat-powered Rewrite feature by late October 2026, enabling users to draft and rephrase text via right-click. It’s enabled by default, respects DLP policies, and can be managed by admins through the InlineComposeEnabled policy.

item.description: What and why:New and updated resources are available whether you’re a seasoned IT pro or earlier in your career. Learn how to effectively roll out feature updates to Windows devices and Microsoft 365 Apps in advance of the upcoming Windows 11, version 26H2. Rollout schedule:All these resources are freely available now.The Windows 11, version 26H2 annual feature update is coming soon. Impact on your organization:You can deploy updates faster and support your remote workforce by following a three-...

item.title: MC1459129: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning retirement of Microsoft 365 training content
item.description: Microsoft is retiring 161 Microsoft 365 training modules and selected articles from Viva Learning on September 21, 2026. Users will lose access after August 30, 2026. Learning administrators should update learning paths, encourage completion of in-progress training, and monitor future communications for replacement content.

item.title: MC1009930: Microsoft Teams: Distinguish invites among Attendee, Presenter, and Co-organizer emails
item.description: Microsoft Teams will send separate event invites based on participant roles—Attendee, Presenter, and Co-organizer—allowing organizers to manage distinct invites for town halls. Rollout starts early November 2026, completing by mid-December, with no admin action needed. Users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1459141: Microsoft Teams: Admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings, enhancing security. The rollout starts mid-September 2026, with default off. Admins can enable and assign this policy; no changes occur unless activated. Recommendations include piloting and communication.

item.title: MC1469565: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for archive mailboxes
item.description: Microsoft is retiring Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online by April 2027 and expanding Microsoft Graph API support for archive mailboxes. Organizations must migrate applications from EWS to Microsoft Graph APIs by October 2026 to maintain archive mailbox access, compliance, eDiscovery, and data lifecycle management.

item.title: MC1469564: Microsoft Publisher: Reminder that support ends in October 2026
item.description: Microsoft Publisher support ends October 1, 2026; it will no longer be available in Microsoft 365 subscriptions. Users should convert or migrate Publisher files to Word, PowerPoint, or Microsoft Create templates before this date. Support for the perpetual version ends October 13, 2026.

item.title: MC1469557: [Whiteboard] Standalone app deprecation (Windows, Mobile)
item.description: Microsoft will retire standalone Whiteboard apps for Windows, iOS, and Android on October 16, 2026. Users must switch to accessing Whiteboard via Microsoft Teams or supported web experiences. Admins should inform users, update resources, and ensure readiness for this transition.

item.title: MC1469555: Microsoft Entra: Optimized passkey registration campaign experience
item.description: Microsoft Entra is enhancing passkey registration campaigns to optimize user experience and increase phishing-resistant authentication adoption. Eligible users will be automatically prompted based on qualifying passkey profiles. Rollout begins early September 2026. Administrators should review campaign configurations and user assignments before rollout.

item.title: MC1469551: Teams admin center device state rules and health alerts retire; use Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams admin center's device state rules and health alerts will retire by late September 2026. Device health monitoring moves to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, which offers unified monitoring and alerting. Admins must reconfigure alerts and integrations in the new portal; end-user experience remains unchanged.

item.title: RM569933: Planner: Task History
item.description: Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.

item.title: RM561035: Microsoft Edge: Allow M365 authentication popups in work profiles
item.description: When users are signed in with a work account, some Microsoft 365 sites (for example, microsoft.com, cloud.microsoft, and microsoft365.com) may open authentication pop-up windows to Microsoft sign-in endpoints such as login.microsoftonline.com, login.live.com, or login.microsoft.com. These pop-ups are required to complete sign-in. Microsoft Edge now allows authentication pop-up windows from Microsoft first party services by default. Admins can control availability to this feature using the M365Au...

item.title: RM570847: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
item.description: Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.

item.title: RM522096: Microsoft Purview: Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access to enable sensitive file filtering at the network layer
item.description: Extend Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies to filter sensitive files at the network layer by integrating with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect files at the network layer and enforce restrictive actions based on DLP policy conditions. It helps prevent sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications through browsers, apps, APIs, add-ins, and more - including generative AI platforms, clou...

item.title: RM547749: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard at Day Level
item.description: This feature enables users to export fresher row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis at day level. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM550513: Microsoft Clipchamp: Upgraded music selection for Copilot AI Videos
item.description: With a Microsoft365 Copilot license, Copilot AI-generated video projects have improved audio with realistic AI voiceover, professional sound effects, and enhanced audio mixing.

item.title: RM557560: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): AI Generated video drafts include text animations and new layout options
item.description: Users will find updated layouts and text animations on video projects generated with Copilot.

item.title: RM560548: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Configure user and survey data retention for deleted users in Viva Glint
item.description: With the new control in Viva Glint, service administrators can now configure whether to retain or delete survey and relevant indefinable user data for users who are manually deleted from Glint or deleted via the signals received via Microsoft Entra. This will ensure that the consistency of previously generate Glint survey reports is retained and user data is handled in accordance with the relevant organizational policies. We will also process the delete signals received via Microsoft Entra and h...

For example, any number of non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompts and responses that collectively amount to 1 GB of retained data will be billed at $0.25 per GB per month (equivalent to ~$0.0082 per GB per day). In the updated model, DLM is billed based on the total volume of text messages managed by a DLM policy. Each non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompt and response is treated as an individual text message...

item.title: RM568932: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with list form in Workflows
item.description: Starts a workflow with a form to collect the information you need to run the rest of your workflow.

item.title: RM567319: Outlook: Categorize Emails by Dragging Them onto a Favorite Category
item.description: You can now add a category to your Favorites and then drag emails right onto it to apply that category. No need to open menus or right-click each message. Just pin the category you use most to Favorites, then drop your emails on it to tag them in one quick motion. It's a faster, more visual way to keep your inbox sorted the way you like. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM568791: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
item.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans.

item.title: RM570845: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

item.title: RM570668: Microsoft 365: Teams Channel Backup
item.description: A backup and recovery feature that lets you recover team & channel data (like files, messages exchanged over channels) in Microsoft Teams to a previously known good state after accidental changes or security compromises. Supported items include Team, Channels (Standard, Private, Public) and underlying data. Retention period supported is 30 days.

item.title: RM570448: OneDrive: Sync support for up to 1 million items on macOS
item.description: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on macOS devices, helping teams manage large document libraries and shared content at scale without compromising access across devices. This preview requires the Insiders ring and that devices meet minimum hardware and configuration requirements. Devices that don't meet these requirements continue to sync at the existing 300,000-item supported limit with no disruption.

item.title: RM570429: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Survey taking experience refinements
item.description: This feature is a collection of improvements including updates to the auto-save experience for comments, simplifying survey navigation through buttons by consolidating the "Skip" and "Done" buttons into a single "Next" button, and to give the survey taker greater control over question progression by refining the auto-scroll behavior when updating answers to questions.

item.title: RM570153: Planner: Add times to task start, finish, and due dates
item.description: Add specific times to task start, finish, and due dates. Define a plan’s time zone and working hours to automatically provide default task times and choose whether to view times in the plan’s time zone or your local time zone. This helps distributed teams coordinate effectively across time zones and keep deadlines clear.

item.title: RM392838: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Introduction of secure workflow to bypass legal holds and retention policies
item.description: The first release of Priority cleanup enables admins to create a recurring exception to delete items under a broader retention policy and/or legal hold on Exchange workload. Creating a Priority cleanup will require a separate security role, multiple approvers, and will have a complete audit trail.

item.title: RM570842: Dynamics 365 Finance: Support requirements of tax reform in Brazil in 2027
item.description: Microsoft plans to introduce additional Globalization Studio capabilities to help support Brazil tax reform requirements, including the new IS tax type, tax assessment capabilities for reformed taxes, expanded fiscal note functionality for additional business scenarios, enhanced tax posting processes, and further updates to CNPJ-related processes. Additional capabilities will continue to be introduced as future phases of Brazil's tax reform are implemented.

item.title: MC1466762: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
item.description: SharePoint News can now be cross-posted to Viva Engage communities with full fidelity and unified conversations across feeds, Outlook, Teams, and apps. Rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, this feature synchronizes comments and reactions, enhancing content reach without extra effort. Admins should inform users accordingly.

item.title: MC1469329: Build apps in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork
item.description: Microsoft announces a preview of app-building in Copilot Cowork starting September 8, 2026, with Copilot Studio following soon. Users with licenses can create, test, and publish apps using natural language and organizational data, governed by existing policies and managed via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.description: The September 2026 security update is now available for all supported versions of Windows. We recommend that you install these updates promptly.
